issue.title: Retire v1_import_retired
issue.description: The legacy v1 agents-sync import leg is sunset: v1 payloads stay readable as evidence but are never imported.

task_type_fields.remove_when: No project reports any origin: import_v1 registry entries or pending legacy-v1 hoods left to migrate, so no machine still depends on the v1 import leg.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: The v1 import leg still materializes legacy v1 bundles as imported artifacts through integrate_foreign_bundles, for a straggler machine mid-migration to v2.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: The v1 import leg (integrate_foreign_bundles, reached via incoming_integration.py from both the cached and full-sync passes) is skipped: legacy v1 hoods are still captured as cache evidence for the v2-adoption matcher but are never materialized as imported artifacts.
